title: dipteryx charapilla
intro: Dipteryx charapilla, commonly known as the "Charapilla tree" or "Piquia", is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Dipteryx charapilla include the reduction of inflammation, the improvement of cardiovascular health, and the potential treatment of diabetes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
